:''For the secret statue, see: [[Random Events#Stone Owl|Secret Stone Owl]]''
The '''Stone Owl''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased on [[Winter|Winter 17]] from the [[Night Market#Magic Shop Boat|Magic Shop Boat]] at the [[Night Market]] for {{Price|500}}.  It may be placed anywhere in Stardew Valley, indoors or out.

This Stone Owl is unrelated to the secret stone owl statue that may randomly appear on [[The Farm|the farm]] overnight.

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Can now be stacked in a player's [[inventory]] and in [[Chest|chests]].}}
